name: happyhorse-1.1-t2v
description: HappyHorse-1.1-T2V supports text-to-video generation, further enhancing text semantic understanding, camera control, and dynamic generation performance. The model can more accurately reproduce creative intent, generating higher-quality videos with smoother, more natural character movements, scene atmosphere, visual aesthetics, and physical motion—rich in detail and with greater consistency.
zhDescription: HappyHorse-1.1-T2V支持文生视频，进一步提升文本语义理解、镜头调度与动态生成表现。模型能够更精准地还原创作意图，在人物动作、场景氛围、视觉美感和物理运动上生成更流畅自然、细节丰富且一致性更高的高质量视频。

modelParameters.label: Max Tokens
modelParameters.description: 单次生成的最大 token 数量

modelParameters.description: 频率惩罚，减少重复内容的生成
